items.description: 发现 12 个资源没有正确配置资源请求/限制
items.details:
- Deployment/devops-agent-argocd-repo-server (命名空间: argocd): Deployment 'devops-agent-argocd-repo-server' in namespace 'argocd' has 1 container(s) without resource limits: copyutil
- Deployment/devops-agent-argocd-repo-server (命名空间: argocd): Deployment 'devops-agent-argocd-repo-server' in namespace 'argocd' has 1 container(s) without resource requests: copyutil
- Pod/devops-agent-argocd-repo-server-7576664677-9lvws (命名空间: argocd): Pod 'devops-agent-argocd-repo-server-7576664677-9lvws' in namespace 'argocd' has 1 container(s) without resource limits: copyutil
- Pod/devops-agent-argocd-repo-server-7576664677-9lvws (命名空间: argocd): Pod 'devops-agent-argocd-repo-server-7576664677-9lvws' in namespace 'argocd' has 1 container(s) without resource requests: copyutil
- Pod/opensearch-cluster-data-0 (命名空间: kubesphere-logging-system): Pod 'opensearch-cluster-data-0' in namespace 'kubesphere-logging-system' has 1 container(s) without resource requests: fsgroup-volume
- Pod/opensearch-cluster-data-0 (命名空间: kubesphere-logging-system): Pod 'opensearch-cluster-data-0' in namespace 'kubesphere-logging-system' has 2 container(s) without resource limits: opensearch-data, fsgroup-volume
- Pod/opensearch-cluster-data-1 (命名空间: kubesphere-logging-system): Pod 'opensearch-cluster-data-1' in namespace 'kubesphere-logging-system' has 1 container(s) without resource requests: fsgroup-volume
- Pod/opensearch-cluster-data-1 (命名空间: kubesphere-logging-system): Pod 'opensearch-cluster-data-1' in namespace 'kubesphere-logging-system' has 2 container(s) without resource limits: opensearch-data, fsgroup-volume
- Pod/opensearch-cluster-data-2 (命名空间: kubesphere-logging-system): Pod 'opensearch-cluster-data-2' in namespace 'kubesphere-logging-system' has 1 container(s) without resource requests: fsgroup-volume
- Pod/opensearch-cluster-data-2 (命名空间: kubesphere-logging-system): Pod 'opensearch-cluster-data-2' in namespace 'kubesphere-logging-system' has 2 container(s) without resource limits: opensearch-data, fsgroup-volume
- Pod/opensearch-cluster-master-0 (命名空间: kubesphere-logging-system): Pod 'opensearch-cluster-master-0' in namespace 'kubesphere-logging-system' has 1 container(s) without resource requests: fsgroup-volume
- Pod/opensearch-cluster-master-0 (命名空间: kubesphere-logging-system): Pod 'opensearch-cluster-master-0' in namespace 'kubesphere-logging-system' has 2 container(s) without resource limits: opensearch-master, fsgroup-volume
items.solution:
为所有容器设置资源请求和限制，避免资源竞争和节点过载：

1. 为每个容器设置合理的资源请求值：
   ```yaml
   resources:
     requests:
       memory: "128Mi"
       cpu: "100m"
   ```

2. 为每个容器设置适当的资源限制值：
   ```yaml
   resources:
     limits:
       memory: "256Mi"
       cpu: "500m"
   ```

3. 监控应用实际资源使用情况，根据使用模式调整请求和限制值
4. 考虑使用LimitRange或ResourceQuota管理命名空间内资源分配
5. 为不同环境(开发、测试、生产)设置不同的资源配置
